name: Premalaya Social Development Society
description: Premalaya Social Development Society works for the well-being of downtrodden and vulnerable sections in Tiruvallur, Chennai Districts of Tamilnadu and in Prakasam, Nellore Districts of Andhra Pradesh. It works in the community development through education, health, advocacy, communication and social mobilization.
